en: Straight from the top of a snowy mountain to deep beneath a burning desert, eh<FH> Do you think this is all part of the trial<FH>
Gragwort must spend a lot of slime on his own living on top of that mountain. Do you think he gets lonely up there<FH>
Even as Crown Prince of Dunisia, I had no idea such a treasure was hidden away in the family tomb. I wonder if my father knew...
Gragwort's Grotto, eh<FH> Rather an unassuming name for the resting place of a legendary weapon, don't you think<FH>
A holy jewel sleepin' deep beneath an ancient pyramid... Now that's got the auld nose fer treasure tinglin' somethin' rotten<FG>
We TOLD him we didn't have any time, and still he sends us off on a silly errand<FG> I hate that horrid little monster already<FG>
Gragwort's got such a funny little face. Whenever I think of him, I can't stop laughing<FG> Hurf hurf hurf<FG>
So these trials test your skills and earn you prizes<FH> I might try some solo...
One minute we're up a freezin' mountain, the next we're bein' sent to a boilin' desert<FG> Talk about outta the freezer an' into the fryin' pan<FG>
Come, we have to hurry. For the sake of everyone who awaits us in the Great Divide, we must pass this trial<FG>
Flitting back and forth between a freezing cold mountain and a boiling desert can't be good for the health. I hope I don't catch cold...
So, we have to pass that little monster's trial to get our hands on the legendary weapon, do we<FH> What exactly does he want us to do<FH>
How much more pleasurable this trial would be if that charming ghost girl were our guide, and not that grumpy, stumpy...thing.
Alriiight<FG> The legendary weapon is ours<MV>not that I have any idea what it is. Let's get it back to the Great Divide and find out<FG>
It isn't exactly what I was expecting, but we've managed to get hold of the legendary weapon. Come on, let's get it over to the Great Divide<FG>
I wonder what's inside that little box that Gragwort gave us<FH> Goowee, I can't wait to find out<FG>
Those rocks won't hold the drakulard down forever. We need to get back to the Great Divide. Now.
We have to hurry back to the Great Divide. His Radiance will be awaiting our return.
I hadn't bargained on the legendary weapon bein' a quare little box like that. What the devil could be lurkin' inside it<FH>
Hee hee<FG> Now that we've got the legendary weapon, we can give that big bully a taste of his own medicine<FG>
Aoooooo<FG> It's time to get our revenge<FG> That drakulard's going to pay<FG>
We got what we need, right<FH> C'mon<MV>let's go cut that colossal creep down to size before it pulls itself free.
That ultimate weapon doodad ain't exactly how I pictured it. I thought it'd be bigger...an' spikier, an'...a bit less...boxy.
The cards are telling me that something terrible is about to happen in the Great Divide. We must return there as soon as we can.
If I never have to climb that awful-awful mountain again, it'll be too soon<FG> Right then, let's go and take down that drakulard<FG>
The armies of all of your allies are waiting for us at the Great Divide, aren't they<FH> Come on<MV>we can't let them down<FG>
So the legendary weapon is inside that little box, is it<FH> You're sure this isn't another one of Gragwort's little jokes<FH>
Alriiight<FG> We're gonna bring peace back to the world even if we have to fight every monster in the Seven Realms to do it<FG>
The enemy are on their last legs. If we hit them now, we might just be able to win this<FG>
...Ahem<FG> Listen up, Private <F4><I0>01<FG> This may be our final battle<MV>it's time to show those baddies the fruits of our training<FG>
The morale of the troops is at an all-time high. They are ready to finish this. And so am I<FG>
The tide of battle is in our favour. If we can keep piling on the pressure for just a little longer, we might just emerge victorious.
So the legendary weapon was a monster medal all along<FG> When that giant jumped out, it put the heart across me somethin' fierce<FG>
If those monsters think they can walk all over me, they've got another thing coming<FG> I'll soon wipe the smirk off their silly king's face<FG>
Aoooooo<FG> We beat the big, bad baddie<FG> Come on, let's go and finish off the rest of them<FG>
The monsters are on the ropes. Let's finish them, finish their boss and get this done.
Reckon it's right about time for the big push<FG> We'll wallop those monsters so hard, they won't know what hit 'em<FG>
The cards are very clear<MV>if we fight with all our might, we will win. Trust in your friends, and we are sure to emerge victorious<FG>
Alright, it's time for my encore<FG> I'll dance up a storm that'll blow those monsters away<FG>
If we can win this battle, your world will be at peace again, correct<FH> Then what are we waiting for<FH> Let's give it everything we've got<FG>
If the ladies of our little band are going to be giving it their all, I suppose I'd better make a little effort myself...
You say that you defeated fiend of superlative size just prior to our appearance<FH> Aga<FG> How I repent that we did not arrive more soon<FG>
Tsarevna Alena is heiress to throne of Zamoksva. Often, she does not act in typical princessly form, but that is why I so adore<MV>
...I, I mean of course ADMIRE her<FG> Please to overlook my entirely innocent slip of speech<FG>
So the only way into the Black Manse is through another world, eh<FH> Looks like it's our turn to do some dimension-hopping<FG>
If what Desdemona says is true, there's a ruined twin of our world out there. We just need to find out how to get there...
When the other world got destroyed, what happened to all the people<FH> Did they all get turned into ghosts and gools...<FH> (quiver)
The entrance to the Tomb of the Sun lies atop the plateau in the Grand Dunes. Let's go and see if this secret path really exists.
Why would High King Unos make a secret path to the ruined world<FH> Did he know that his descendants would need to use it one day<FH>
Jaypers, that Tomb o' the Sun's just brimmin' with secrets, so it is<FG> What say we go an' have a little look around<FH>
I think this Unos person just wanted to go home, even if his home had been smashed to bits. That's why he built this path.
So this other world is where your great-great-great-great-grandad used to live<FH> Cor, I can't wait to see it<FG>
The entrance to the other world's in the Tomb of the Sun, huh<FH> Then let's move.
This other world we're headed to got busted up by the Dreadbolt, huh<FH> Here's hopin' the secret entrance didn't get busted up too...
I consulted the cards to learn more of this other world, but all was shrouded in darkness. We will just have to go there and see...
The Tomb of the Sun's where we found that sparkly-sparkly jewel, isn't it<FH> I don't remember seeing any secret paths...
So Unos and Fractos had teleportals to each other's castles, did they<FH> They must have been close...before they tried to kill each other.
A beauty, a scholar and an enchantress beyond compare... I do believe the Queen of Ingenia may be the woman of my dreams...
Queen of Ingenia's tale of teleportals is supremely helpful<FG> Let us make with haste to Tomb of Sun, and search this portal out<FG>
I was fearful that route to Black Manse may involve flight or ascent to sickening heights. News of this teleportal gladdens me indeed<FG>
If Fractos fires off another Dreadbolt, our world will be ruined just like that other one was. We've got to stop him<FG>
If Fractos unleashes the Dreadbolt again, our world will be plunged into darkness just like that other one was. We can't let that happen<FG>
Do you think the dark world oozed to be full of innocent people just gooing about their daily lives<FH> It's so sad... (sniff)
He destroyed his own world<MV>his own people<MV>to satisfy his ambition... I will never forgive Fractos for what he has done. Never<FG>
For a thousand years, Fractos has been hiding in that cursed world, perfecting his evil plans, and awaiting the day he could fulfil them...
When I think o' them poor souls trapped in that dark an' gloomy world fer such a long auld time, it makes me heart bleed, so it does...
I don't want to end up a ghost like all of Unos's friends. We've got to stop Fractos before he fires off that Dreadbolt thing again<FG>
I can't smell anything nice in that dark world... No people, no flowers, no food... I don't really want to go back unless we have to...
So Fractos wants to ruin this world just like he did the other one, huh<FH> Where does this guy get off<FH>
So there might be some kinda portal to Fractos's nasty old castle in that other world, huh<FH> Whaddya say we go find it<FH>
Imagine having to seal your own brother away...and in the world you love... King Unos must have been so, so sad...
The longer we spend in that gloomy world, the gloomier I feel. Let's hurry up and find this teleportal before I lose the will to live<FG>
That other world looks just like this one, but with all the joy drained out of it. It's so eerie... Like seeing an evil version of yourself...
Is Desdemona really a member of Fractos's family<FH> Hard to believe that the descendant of one so foul could be so fair...
To extinguish innocents and additionally entire worlds is unforgivable indeed<FG> Truly, Fractos is lower than low<FG>
O Goddess in heavens above<FG> Have mercy on poor despairing souls in overshadowed world, I pray You<FG>
The Black Manse... Fractos is in that castle right now plotting his next move. Let's get up there and bring him down<FG>
The Black Manse... That's where Fractos is hiding. Let's go and flush him out so we can bring his evil plans to an end<FG>
If we beat Fractos, this world will be at peace again. That is why I, the couragooze Sir Healix, shall keep fighting with all my might<FG>
Fractos is gathering the evil energy he needs to unleash the Dreadbolt as we speak. We must defeat him before he can do so<FG>
Come on, let's go. It's time to settle the fight our ancestors started a thousand years ago<FG>
Jaykers, that floatin' fortress is a scaresome sight, so it is<FG> Whenever I catch a glimpse of it, it puts the wind right up me<FG>
That Black Manse is just as horrible on the inside as it is on the outside. Why would anyone want to live in a place like that<FH>
We've got to beat Fractos<MV>not just for the people of this world, but for everyone in the other one too<FG>
You need my help<FH> You got it. Nobody's got what it takes to beat me<MV>not even a thousand-year-old monster king.
It's time to take out the trash<FG> Let's smash our way into Fractos's house an' give that sucker the ol' heave-ho<FG>
The cards tell me that a terrible trial awaits us within the Black Manse... But it is a trial we must face<MV>one which will decide our fate...
I'm not usually one to complain about visiting kings in their castles, but Fractos<FH> Ugh<FG> I can't wait to see that place come tumbling down<FG>
There was a floating castle back in our world too, you know. It was a strange, twisted place, ruled over by the Lord of Darkness himself...
These arch-villain types do love a foreboding fortress of evil, don't they<FH> Oh, to meet one with a little taste for once...
Uraaa<FG> Your time is arrived, Fractos<FG> Obliteration is at hand<MV>my hand<FG> And additionally my feet<FG>
I am petrified to fight high in sky atop flying castle...but if it will assist to save realms from demolition, I shall to vanquish my fears<FG>
Good. One more thing<MV>the gateway between the Lumberlands and Dunisia has been reopened. There is no more need for suspicion.
The three of us, reunited at last, eh<FH> Just like old times<FG> There was never anything we couldn't do when we put our heads together<FG>
Hm. Something tells me the problems we face these days are a little less...surmountable.
Come now<MV>let us join forces, and restore peace to Harba<FG>
Oh, don't be such a misery guts<FG> We're ten times tougher than we used to be<FG> Together, we'll be unstoppable<FG>
<F4><I0>00 and co. learn the art of tag tricks<FG>
Graaarrrgh<FG> Free at lassst<FG> Thank you, ssstranger<FG>
Heh heh heh<FG> Nobody locks me up an' gets away wiv it<FG> It's payback time<FG>
It doesn't seem too keen to leave the comfort of the cell...
There's a message scratched into the wall of the cell. <F4><I0>01 tries to make out what it says...
NOT USED
Forgive me, but I cannot allow you to pass<FG> We are at war with the countries of the Beastlands<MV>the path ahead is too dangerous<FG>
We need to get to this Ingenia place, right<FH> Well<FH> What are we waiting for<FH>
So this is a whole 'nother world, huh<FH> Good job we bumped into you guys, or I'd be lookin' for the path back to Port Haven right about now<FG>
‘Continue eastward to reach the oasis.’
Do you journey to Accordia, friends<FH> Then there is something I must tell you.
Though the road ahead usually teems with monsters, today not a single one is to be seen. Though this does mean that the way is clear...
I fear that some hidden danger lies in wait. I hesitate to tread the road ahead. Perhaps you should too...
Sorry, I couldn't 'elp over'earin' that you lot're buddin' warriors. I got just the fing for a pair o' beginners. 'Ere...
<F4><S0> receives a pair of heroine's twin swords<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a hero's sword<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a pair of hero's twin swords<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a hero's shield<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a hero's axe<FG>
<F4><S0> receives a heroine's axe<FG>
I was a warrior too till not so long ago, see. I got a new job now, though, so I don't need all this gear no more. Enjoy<FG>
I've been racking my brains trying to work out what to do, but I just can't think of anything...
‘Path diverges ahead. Take the eastern fork to reach Ingenia. Follow the path to the south to reach the graveyard.’
‘Follow the path north to reach Redrock Ravine. Follow the path east to reach Ingenia.’
‘Graveyard ahead. Due to recent monster attacks, no unauthorised persons are permitted to enter.’
‘Welcome to the WildwoooOOOoood<FG>\nEnter if you dare, if you dare<FG>’
‘Path diverges ahead. Take the eastern fork to reach Ingenia. Follow the path to the north-west to reach Accordia.’
I'm ever so sorry<FG> I can't do anything for you away from the inn<FG> Oh, I hope everyone in Accordia is alright...
Everyone in Accordia looks so happy. I still can't believe the war's really over...
Alriiight<FG> This party's gonna be so much fun<FG> I'm gonna let my hair down all the way to my ankles<FG>
Hee hee... Ruff's really nice<FG> I'm sooo glad we became friends<FG> (slurp)
To sit in my father's throne, or to join Lady Desdemona in tracking down the man who may have killed him... How am I supposed to decide<FH>
Prince Cesar is keen to join me in searching for the black-robed seer, but...I don't know. With his father gone, his people need him.
There'll be all manner o' peddlers an' traders an' what have ye at this party, eh<FH> I'd best put together a few wares o' me own, so...
So the war's finally over, and we can start looking for a way home. You know, I might almost miss this place...
...N-Not that I'll be sad to say goodbye or anything<FG> The sooner I can get back to my big bath and my feather bed, the better<FG>
Playing drill sergeants is so much fun<FG> Healix is grrreat<FG> Actually, no<MV>he's ‘gooreat’<FG> Hurf hurf hurf<FG>
Parties aren't exactly my thing. But I'll tag along. Just out of curiosity.
We've been through hell an' high water, but we finally got this whole mess sorted out<FG> Now it's time to blow off some steam<FG>
Arey... Why must we have a party on the eve of an important ceremony<FH> My sister is sure to overdo it and be in no fit state tomorrow...
Yahoooooo<FG> It's party time<FG> I'm going to eat and drink and dance until I can't eat or drink or dance any more<FG>
I can't shake the feeling that this isn't quite over, but we've at least put a stop to the war. If that isn't reason to celebrate, nothing is<FG>
What a splendid idea this party is. No doubt the ladies of Accordia will be eager to offer their...thanks...to the heroes of the hour...
Friend Torneko advised me of many trying adversities you endured together. Aga<FG> If only I had arrived in this world more soon<FG>
It seems many hardships have assailed you, but these are now overcome. Is time to offer thanks, and to make celebrations for peace.
‘But till the land be steeped in blood,\nMay sovereign twins, however good,\nNe'er hope to rule in peace forever more...’
They looked an awful lot like a pair of sovereign twins to me, you know. Maybe the prophecy wasn't just a warning after all...
Everyone was having such a good time at the party... Why did the High King have to goo and ruin everything<FH> (slurp) It's so sad...
Not only did the High King betray his people, he betrayed his most loyal servant. I will not forgive him. And nor will Lady Desdemona...
I'm sure I've heard something about the Cover of Darkness before, but I can't seem to put my finger on it...
Sure, an' it's odd to have to think o' the High King as an enemy now, so it is. Not half as hard as it must be for youse, though, eh...
Just when we think the war's all over, the King of Accordia goes and tries to kill us all<FG> Well, he won't get a second chance if I can help it<FG>
I don't get it... Why would the High King try to get rid of us<FH> I thought we were friends...
We won't be taking the city back until we've figured out how to deal with the Cover of Darkness...
What was the deal with that darkness comin' outta the High King's cup<FH> Ya don't think the little guy's been drinkin' the stuff, do ya<FH>
I felt a darkness deeper than any I have felt before emanating from those monsters in Accordia...
Only the power of the light can dispel that darkness...but it would have to be a source of light brighter than even the sun itself...
I always thought the King of Accordia was such a darling little fellow, but he was a scheming old sourpuss all along<FG>
So all this chaos is the fault of an ancient prophecy, is it<FH> Whoever came up with that silly rhyme has a lot to answer for...
How the High King could send monsters to murder his former friends without even batting an eyelid is simply beyond me...
How is Supreme Sovereign capable to stab innocent citizens in back<FG><FH> Such behaviour is inexcusable<FG>
Though we made secure getaway from city, many were not so fortuitous. We must to recapture capital without delay<FG>
Worrying about the prophecy isn't going to get us anywhere. We just have to do what we think is right<FG>
Cesar's right<MV>worrying about the prophecy isn't going to get us anywhere. We've just got to do what we think is right<FG>
That's what I like to see, soldier<FG> You've got that fire in your eyes<FG> Let's goo, goo, goo<FG>
The Tomb of the Sun has always been off limits to all but the royal family of Dunisia...but we can make an exception this once.
We need to get to the Tomb of the Sun and find this jewel. It's our only chance if we want to save Accordia.
Ye've to strike while the iron's hot, or so they say<FG> Let's head over to the desert an' see if we can't find this Heart o' Brightness yoke.
King Unos was buried a thousand years ago, right<FH> We'll be lucky if grave robbers haven't been in and stolen this treasure of his by now.
Hooray<FG> We're going on another adventure<FG> ...I know there's a lot of horrible things going on, but it doesn't mean we can't have fun<FG>
We're not gonna solve anything standing around here. We need to head for the Tomb of the Sun.
I know you guys are frettin' about goin' against the prophecy, but ya gotta take a leaf outta my book<MV>quit thinkin' and start doin'<FG>
The cards tell me that we must follow our own path. No matter what the prophecy might say, our own judgement is all that matters.
The Tomb of the Sun, eh<FH> Oh, I can just imagine it<MV>a treasure trove piled high with gold and jewels shining like sunbeams<FG>
High King Unos and High King Fractos, eh<FH> So the ones who turned this world upside down a thousand years ago were twins too...
In the absence of any real idea of what's going on, I say we follow whatever clues we can. To the Tomb of the Sun, without delay<FG>
Come, let us proceed to Tomb of Sun<FG> With Heart of Brightness, fiendish occupiers of Accordia will no longer evade my pummellings<FG>
We must to search for treasure in Tomb of Sun... Praises be that it is not ‘Tower of Sun’, or my legs would be instantly jellified<FG>
It's time to take back Accordia<FG> Forget about the prophecy<MV>let's just concentrate on saving the city<FG>
Alriiight, it's time to take back Accordia<FG> Let's give this everything we've got<FG>
Cover of Darkness, Shmover of Darkness<FG> After we've oozed the Heart of Brightness, those baddies won't stand a chance<FG>
The people of Accordia need our help. We must leave for the city as soon as you're ready.
This is going to be a long, hard battle. There's no telling what monsters are roaming the city streets, so be sure you're ready for anything.
Yerra, 'tis awful to have yer home invaded by monsters. Let's go an' give the Accordians a hand with their little pest problem, eh<FH>
I hope the High King's watching when we take back Accordia<FG> He's about to find out what happens when you mess with Maribel Mayde<FG>
Aoooooo<FG> Is it nearly time to go and take Accordia back from the monsters<FH> I can't wait<FG>
Heh. Without the Cover of Darkness protecting them, those monsters'll be sitting ducks.
Now we got the Heart o' Brightness, there ain't no stoppin' us<FG> Let's head back to town an' kick those party-crashers to the kerb<FG>
Now that we have the Heart of Brightness, we have a chance...and it is one that we must take.
High King Unos was such a clever-clever man, leaving that treasure behind for us to find<FG> Come on, let's go and put it to good use<FG>
We've found the Heart of Brightness<MV>now all we have to do is go to Accordia and free it from the darkness<FG>
Accordia is occupied by a formidable army of monsters. Don't you think you'd be better off preparing for battle than chatting with me<FH>
Now that Heart of Brightness is in hand, fiends shall not escape my punchings<FG> Let us advance to Accordia and commence fisticuffs<FG>
Purifying power of Heart of Brightness will surely divest monsters of darkness. Then we will trounce them and recapture city<FG>
<F4><I0>41 is now attuned to this Zoomstone<FG>
Grrr<FG> (slurp) Are you slacking off, soldier<FH> If you've got slime to chat, you've got slime to train<FG> Drop and give me fifty<FG>
What do you want<FH> Do I have something on my face<FH>
We should head out on manoeuvres somewhere. You two are still in training<MV>you need to keep your hand in.
After a long day's dungeoneerin', there's nuttin' like gazin' over the hustle an' bustle of a busy town to get yer vinnom back<FG>
Ugh<FG> All this traipsing backwards and forwards has made me all sweaty. I demand a bath<FG>
Aooo<FG> I'm absolutely staaarving<FG> Have you got anything I can eat in that big bag of yours<FH>
If you're at a loose end, go sharpen your blades. When the going gets tough, you'll need whatever edge you can get.
I ain't boastin' or nothin', but it takes a lotta hard work to get a body like this...an' one heck of a lotta raw eggs<FG>
Whatever you do, do not lend my sister even a single gold coin. She will gamble it away, and then beg for more<FG>
Accordia's so big and bustling and beautiful...so why in the world does it not have a casino<FG><FH> What do you people do for fun<FG><FH>
I'm rather a dab hand at slinging spells, you know. If you need something<MV>or someone<MV>blasted to smithereens, just say the word<FG>
Jessica continues to resist my charms. It must be a constant struggle for the poor girl...
Have you tournaments of bare-knuckle brutality in this world<FH> If so, I will be pleased to make entrance<MV>and to emerge victorious<FG>
Many breath-catching sights are to be seen in these Seven Realms, but none is comparing to beauty of Zamoksva, birthplace of Tsarevna<FG>
What say we join forces and teach the rest of these rogues a lesson<FH> Some might even prove worthy of our combined prowess<FG>
Ah... So you are the ones who have chosen to undertake my trial. Interesting...
My friend the orb seller has deemed you worthy of this challenge, hm<FH> Yes... I can see you have the makings of master thieves...
‘Master thieves’...<FH> What are you talking about<FH> And who exactly are you, anyway<FH>
Ho ho ho<FG> It does not matter who I am<FG> All that matters is that we discover whether you truly have what it takes to earn your reward...
Good luck, my young apprentices. I shall be watching you...from the shadows...
Wh-What the<MV><FG><FH> He just disappeared<FG> Who in the world was that<FH>
No idea. All I know for sure is this quest he's given us is definitely a little bit dodgy...
Still, we can't be upstanding citizens all our lives<FG> Let's give it a go<FG>
I've made a note of the stuff I'm after<MV>I'll send it along to the questmistress. If you can collect it for me, I'll owe you big<FG>
Did you forget something in Ingenia<FH> We haven't got time for detours. Let's focus on the task at hand.
So yer off to give that Fractos bloke a good clobberin', eh<FH> Well, 'ead round the front an' I'll see if I ain't got just the tool for the job.
In all my many years, never have I seen a flying castle. How do you suppose it stays up there<FH>
If you wanna head up into that castle, kiddo, I ain't gonna stop ya. I'll betcha find all sortsa mini medals<FG> You just bring 'em back, capisce<FH>
Do you really plan on going to that horrible castle<FH> I do hope you'll be careful, duckie...
Fractos's castle will be crawling with powerful monsters. Don't go in there unprepared.
When the Pinnacle of Peace was destroyed, it scared the living daylights out of me. I'm so happy none of you were hurt<FG>
Can Fractos truly have returned<FH> I can only pray that the path you must walk to defeat this evil will appear to you...
I can't do much more than pray for your victory over Fractos. But I'll make sure my sisters pray for you too<FG>
If anyone can slay Fractos and restore peace to the world, it's you<FG> I know you can do it<FG>
Please, you have to save us<FG> I know there's not much I can do to help, but I wanted to tell you that we're all behind you<FG>
The king to whom I pledged my life is gone, but I am still sworn to protect the people of Accordia. I will not break my oath.
With the Pinnacle of Peace gone, what's next for Accordia<FH> And what's next for the world<FG><FH>
What do you make of that awful floating castle<FH> I just can't relax with that horrid thing hovering over me the whole time.
Fractos lives in that castle up there, doesn't he<FH> If only I could get up there, I'd give him a right thrashing<FG>
I don't want my brother to fight Fractos<FG> He might get hurt<FG> Can you do it instead, please<FH> Pretty please<FG>
After so many years of life, I thought nothing could surprise me. But I never thought I'd live to see the High King dead and his tower gone<FG>
When you live to be my age, it takes a lot to surprise you. But I'd never imagined I'd see a castle flying in the skies over Accordia...
Tee hee hee<FG> He and I are going out now<FG> What can I say<FH> His moody stare won me over<FG>
I suppose you've already noticed, but she and I are going out now<FG> I'm so glad I finally bit the bullet and asked her<FG>
I wonder what it's like to live in a flying castle... You wouldn't want to be afraid of heights<FG>
What happened to the Pinnacle of Peace<FH> What happened to the King of Accordia<FH>
Hm<FH> Oh, it's you. Don't you try and sneak up on me again<FG>
'Oo'd ever've thought the day'd come when the Pinnacle o' Peace just...weren't there no more<FH> Cor, it brings a tear to me eye...
That Fractos bloke did a right number on the Pinnacle o' Peace, eh<FH> We're lucky the rest of Accordia's still standin'<FG>
His Radiance and the Pinnacle of Peace may be gone, but we can't just sit around moping. We have to pull together and protect the city<FG>
The Pinnacle of Peace was always a symbol of hope for Accordia. It breaks my heart to see it replaced by something so evil...
